# Past Exhibits

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/bb2f68fe-ca9e-44ba-9289-1a86ec0427bf/Waste+is+a+Construct+-+Website+%283%29.png)

### waste is a construct

An art installation using derelict boats to tell environmental stories and reframe waste as a material of possibility.

[Learn More →](https://www.cwb.org/waste)

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/d8eadc05-c3df-4e28-b82b-443a3889f222/Winter+2025+Exhibit.jpg)

### Voyages in Color

Paintings by local artist Saeed Tavakkol capturing Pacific Northwest scenes.

[Learn More →](https://www.cwb.org/voyages-in-color)

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/2ee5f73c-0f3a-4f51-b969-f3ecfc53f894/Marine+Mosaic+Instagram+Cover.png)

### Marine Mosaic

A showcase of BIPOC artists in the Pacific Northwest, curated by intern Emma Ponce Arroyo.

[Learn More →](https://www.cwb.org/marine-mosaic-exhibit)

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/a80072e8-9807-4958-a6c5-e1c03c65c677/IMG_20230623_232807_382.jpg)

### Coast Guard Art Program Exhibit

[The Coast Guard Art Program](https://www.uscg.mil/Community/Art-Program/) uses fine art as public outreach about the service's missions and history.

[Learn More →](https://www.uscg.mil/Community/Art-Program/#:~:text=The%20Coast%20Guard%20Art%20Program%20%28COGAP%29%20uses%20fine,and%20at%20Coast%20Guard%20locations%20throughout%20the%20country.)

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/5e15aaad-4ea0-4092-9a0b-e88a274ef43b/early_mornin_commute.jpeg)

### Pacific Rim Institute of Maritime Artists (returns to cWB!)

Marine and maritime art from artists living on or near the Pacific Rim.

[Learn More →](https://www.cwb.org/prima-exhibit)

![Sailboats sailing on either side Lake Union Wooden Boat festival poster exhibit text](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/1555104638871-QIL5ZQ9V0I9B8VIP5J6R/LAKE%2BUNION%2BWOODEN%2BBOAT%2BFESTIVAL%2BPOSTER%2BEXHIBIT.jpg)

### Lake Union Wooden Boat Festival Poster Exhibit

Celebrating 40 years of festival art, community, and boats.

[Learn More →](https://www.cwb.org/poster-exhibit)

![Highliners lined up at the wharf](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/1555106391098-MVUU8ZV5GH52A30TVIWO/Longline.jpg)

### Highliners: Boats of the Century

The history of Seattle's historic longline power-schooner fleet.

[Learn More →](https://www.cwb.org/highliners-exhibit)

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/9f3d080f-3976-422d-a488-577bfe65a586/Still-Afloat-for-Website-1-630x314.jpg)

### "Still Afloat: Historic Small Craft of King County"

Four historic wooden boat designs from the CWB collection.

[Learn More →](https://www.cwb.org/still-afloat)

![Fish On exhibit wall](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/1555106334037-J4LNQTL0KULIJI2VARH5/IMG_1275-630x314.jpg)

### Fish On!

A history of recreational fishing boathouses and resorts on Puget Sound.

[Learn More →](https://www.cwb.org/fish-on)

![Painting of two tall ships sailing on a stormy sea.](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/1617578559442-EHKOPGC9HZTE4WS6U8ZJ/thumbnail_THE%2BGREAT%2BRACE%252C%2BTHERMOPYLAE%2BVS%2BCUTTY%2BSARK%2Bcopy.jpeg)

### Pacific Rim Institute of Maritime Artists

A mix of historical and modern marine art in many mediums.

[Learn More →](https://www.cwb.org/prima-exhibit)

![Vintage boathouse with a hook or lift in front of a shed door](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/1555106404338-E6583WDGWOB9BNSOKOWM/6.22.1e-rev-630x314-2.jpg)

### Persistent Work

How the history of Western Washington and King County was shaped by work where land meets water.

[Learn More →](https://www.cwb.org/persistent-work)
